prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.prefill: Analyze the posts of the @openai and @googledeepmind and summarize me current trends in the AI.

agentInstructions.title: Agent instructions
agentInstructions.description: Instructions for the agent. Defines who the agent is and what it does.
agentInstructions.default: You are a helpful assistant who aims to help users with their questions and tasks. You provide clear, accurate information and guidance while maintaining a friendly and professional attitude.

modelName.title: OpenAI model
modelName.description: The OpenAI model to use. Currently supported models are gpt-4o and gpt-4o-mini.

mcpUrl.title: MCP Server URL
mcpUrl.description: The URL of the MCP Server to use.

actors.title: Actors included
actors.description: List of Apify Actor names to be available to the agent.

toolTimeout.title: MCP tool call timeout (s)
toolTimeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a tool call to complete.

maxSteps.title: Maximum steps for tool calls
maxSteps.description: Controls the maximum number of sequential LLM calls an agent can make

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: If enabled, Actor provides detailed information with tool calls and reasoning.
